description: The photos in the app-look capture kit (`redlamp recipe app-kit`). Look-development raws (research/look-dev/manifest.json, CC0, downloaded by `mise run lookdev`) are rendered neutrally at 2048 px; the portraits fill the look-dev set's skin gap and are fetched from Wikimedia Commons into build/app-looks/sources/, checked against the SHA-1 Commons publishes, and resized. Licences were checked on each file page on 2026-09-30. Only this list is committed, never the photos.
